summary: neutrino texture pinned to ONE matrix, closing the 7x cascade flag. S3 triality forces the mass matrix into mu-tau-symmetric + magic form whose eigenvectors are the TBM columns (angles fixed by symmetry, not fitted); it has TWO independent mass scales so it fits BOTH Delta m^2 (the one-scale cascade could not). Diagonalising the exact TBM matrix gives sin^2 th=(1/3,1/2,0) and dm21/dm31=0.030 to machine precision; the Phi3=13 deformation moves the angles to (4/13,7/13,2/91), close to observed (0.307,0.546,0.0220), ratio unchanged. Honest: the two scales are fixed by the two observed Delta m^2 (a unique-matrix closure demonstration, not an absolute-mass prediction); TBM structure + 1/Phi3 are the substrate inputs.
